card.name: Start of benzodiazepine and triazole names
card.fires_on: The opening piece of a split drug name, mostly the 'benz' or 'Benz' that begins benzodiazepines. Also 'tri' before azole in triazole antifungals.

modes.label: Benzodiazepine start
modes.description: The first piece of the word benzodiazepine(s), in any casing or spacing.

modes.label: Triazole start
modes.description: The 'tri' piece before 'azole' in antifungal class names.

card.plain: It lights up at the start of a long drug-class name like benzodiazepine, before the rest of the word comes.
